0.original: Alphinaud is ready to bring the people together.

24.original: Show the blessed scale to Mamook's citizens.

26.original: Show the blessed scale to the worker in Golmajiik Grove.

48.original: It's amazing how Wuk Lamat can connect with anyone. She has an incredible gift.

49.original: To think that there was such a dark secret behind blessed siblings... Even among the Mamool Ja, I cannot imagine many know the whole truth─especially not those who reside in the capital.

50.original: The only way to help Mamook is to understand Mamook. We won't let Bakool Ja Ja down!

51.original: ...Sometimes it's best to just forgive and move on. It can be difficult─gods, don't I know it─but that's all the more reason to try your damndest to look past how you were wronged and let bygones be bygones.

52.original: We haven't a moment to lose.

53.original: According to Miilal Ja, Moxutural Zooj is an abandoned settlement northwest of the city. It should afford us the privacy we require.

54.original: We must work quickly, lest Zereel Ja discover our intentions. Fortunately, Bakool Ja Ja thought to give us additional scales, so we might cover more ground in less time.

55.original: Everyone should take one and get going. Use them to gather as many people as you can.

56.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, let's retrace our steps. Maybe this time we can convince folks to lend an ear.

57.original: Look! I've already made a new friend!

59.original: ...That scale. If the blessed trust you, then so will I.

60.original: So, what is it that you require of me?

61.original: Bakool Ja Ja bids us come to Moxutural Zooj?

62.original: A strange place for an assembly, but very well. I will not refuse he who fights for our dreams.

63.original: Did I not tell you to move along? I can't be seen talking with the likes of you!

64.original: A blessed scale? In an outsider's hands? ...What business do you have with me?

65.original: So Bakool Ja Ja sent you to call an assembly... I'm not sure what to make of this, but I shall go to Moxutural Zooj at once.

66.original: Have you managed to gather some of the good folks?

67.original: Wonderful! The esteemed Bakool Ja Ja will be pleased. This fellow here will be coming to Moxutural Zooj as well.

68.original: Apparently, there's a najool nursery to the west called Golmajiik Grove. Could you go and see who you can talk to there as well?

69.original: I'll meet you in Moxutural Zooj afterwards. There's just one more person I need to find!

73.original: Oh! My apologies, I was unaware. I thank you, blessed scale bearer, for bringing me word of this gathering.

74.original: I shall away to Moxutural Zooj at once.

80.original: Now that I think on it, why would Bakool Ja Ja grant you his scale...?

81.original: What a curious place to gather...

82.original: Whatever Bakool Ja Ja requires of me, I shall happily provide.

85.original: You invited the Second Promise as well?

86.original: <sigh> Lamaty'i. Need I remind you that this rite is a competition?

87.original: Whatever advantage you're about to share with me, you ought to utilize to your own benefit. I have barely made headway in communicating with the locals─at this rate, you lead the race to the golden city.

90.original: No, no. Mamook has a problem I can't solve on my own, and you're the most clever person I know.

91.original: I want you to hear the people firsthand, so that we might come up with a way to help them.

92.original: Very well. I am at your disposal.

93.original: Everyone, thank you for gathering on such short notice! I am Wuk Lamat, Third Promise of Tuliyollal.

94.original: Promise? I thought you served Bakool Ja Ja!

96.original: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)No. They did not.

97.original: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The scales they showed you were mine. I entrusted them to the Third Promise and her retinue.

99.original: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Because Wuk Lamat has won my trust. Now, you will hear her words.

100.original: Bakool Ja Ja shared with me the truth about blessed siblings. About the price you pay to conceive them.

101.original: As an outsider to your community, it is not my place to judge you or your culture.

102.original: Culture is born of the experiences of its people. Of their lives and their land.

103.original: But it breaks my heart to know that yours has brought you all so much suffering.

104.original: If any here wish to break from the cycle of tragedy that creating blessed siblings demands, I ask that you join us.

105.original: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Please. I don't want any more of our children to die.

107.original: We have no choice! Only blessed siblings can liberate us from our suffering. Without them, we have nothing!

110.original: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)That remains to be seen. Speak with the Third Promise. Share with her your worries and your pain, and together we may find a new way forward.

112.original: If she is trustworthy...then I will speak with her.

113.original: It would be best if you withdrew, my son. Many cannot yet speak freely in your presence.

114.original: Let's keep an eye out for Zereel Ja. He wouldn't take kindly to this sort of gathering.

115.original: Once we understand everyone's concerns, we'll be better equipped to help them. Let's make sure they feel heard.

120.original: Even if Bakool Ja Ja trusts the Third Promise, I don't know if I'm comfortable discussing this with her...

122.original: Belief in blessed siblings and the salvation they would bring has sustained me for years and years. But if there's another way...if the Third Promise can truly help us...

123.original: I don't know what to think or how to feel about this...

124.original: I'm sure my son would have preferred to stay, but his presence alone still greatly sways our people's behavior.

125.original: I'm glad Koana agreed to help us.

126.original: He's always been good at solving complicated problems. Me, not so much─but I'll support Mamook's people however I can.

127.original: By combining our respective strengths, we'll help them discover a new source of hope. I know we will!
